feature: Real-Time Token Usage Indicator in Status Area
description: Add an optional token counter to the bottom toolbar or status area that shows context size growing in real-time, with visual warnings when approaching context limits.
architecture_notes: The implementation follows the existing Rich UI pattern. TokenTracker is enhanced with limit awareness, and a new TokenUsageIndicator component provides visual display. The indicator integrates with the existing status bar infrastructure and updates after each agent turn via the execute_task flow.

phases.name: Foundation - Model Context Limits
phases.description: Add context limit metadata to model definitions and enhance ModelInfo

subtasks.title: Update models.json with context limits
subtasks.description: Add context_window field to each model in models.json with appropriate token limits: Claude models 200K, GPT-4o 128K, GPT-4o-mini 128K, o1/o3 200K, Gemini 1M+
subtasks.notes: Added context_window field to all models: Claude models 200K, GPT-4o/mini 128K, o1/o3 200K, Gemini 1M

subtasks.title: Extend ModelInfo dataclass with context_window
subtasks.description: Add context_window: int | None field to ModelInfo dataclass and update _load_models_json() to parse it. Default to 128K when unknown.
subtasks.notes: Added context_window: int | None field to ModelInfo dataclass. Added DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 128000 constant. Updated _load_models_json() to parse context_window from JSON. Updated static fallback models and _refresh_models_cache to include context_window.

subtasks.title: Add get_context_limit helper function
subtasks.description: Create get_context_limit(model_identifier: str) -> int function to retrieve context limit for a model, with 128K default when unknown
subtasks.notes: Added get_context_limit(model_identifier: str) -> int function. Looks up model via get_model_info() and returns context_window if available, otherwise returns DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW (128000). Added getContextLimit TypeScript-compat alias.

phases.name: Enhanced TokenTracker
phases.description: Extend TokenTracker class with limit awareness, warning thresholds, and real-time display methods

subtasks.title: Add context limit and threshold properties to TokenTracker
subtasks.description: Add context_limit: int | None property, WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.80, CRITICAL_THRESHOLD = 0.95 constants. Add set_context_limit(limit: int) method.

subtasks.title: Add usage percentage and status calculation methods
subtasks.description: Add get_usage_percentage() -> float | None and get_status_level() -> Literal['normal', 'warning', 'critical', 'unknown'] methods

subtasks.title: Add format_compact_display method
subtasks.description: Create format_compact_display() -> str method returning formatted string like '45K/200K [23%]' or '180K/200K ⚠️ 90%'

subtasks.title: Add warning threshold tracking
subtasks.description: Add _warned_80: bool and _warned_95: bool flags to track if warnings have been shown in current session. Add should_show_warning() method.

phases.name: Token Usage Indicator Component
phases.description: Create a new Rich UI component for displaying token usage in the status area

subtasks.title: Create TokenUsageIndicator class
subtasks.description: Create new component in rich_ui/components/token_indicator.py with TokenUsageIndicator class that takes a TokenTracker and has render() -> Text method
subtasks.notes: Use color coding: green for normal (<80%), yellow for warning (80-95%), red for critical (>95%)

subtasks.title: Export TokenUsageIndicator from components
subtasks.description: Update rich_ui/components/__init__.py to export TokenUsageIndicator

subtasks.title: Integrate indicator into RichStatusBar
subtasks.description: Update RichStatusBar to accept optional TokenTracker and display token usage with color-coded warnings

phases.name: Real-Time Display Integration
phases.description: Integrate the token indicator into the main execution flow for real-time updates

subtasks.title: Add prompt-toolkit bottom toolbar support
subtasks.description: Create get_bottom_toolbar() function that returns formatted token usage for display in prompt-toolkit's bottom_toolbar
subtasks.notes: prompt-toolkit supports bottom_toolbar parameter in prompt() for status display

subtasks.title: Update create_prompt_session with token tracker
subtasks.description: Pass token_tracker to create_prompt_session and configure bottom_toolbar callback to display real-time token usage

subtasks.title: Update simple_cli to set context limit on model selection
subtasks.description: When model is selected/changed, fetch context limit via get_context_limit() and call token_tracker.set_context_limit()

subtasks.title: Show token update after each turn
subtasks.description: After token_tracker.add() in execute_task, optionally print a brief token status update if enabled

phases.name: Configuration and User Preferences
phases.description: Add configuration options to enable/disable and customize the token indicator

subtasks.title: Add show_tokens setting to SessionState
subtasks.description: Add show_tokens: bool field to SessionState, default True. Support KAI_SHOW_TOKENS environment variable override.

subtasks.title: Add CLI flag for token indicator
subtasks.description: Add --show-tokens/--no-tokens CLI flags to control whether token indicator is displayed

subtasks.title: Extend /tokens command with toggle
subtasks.description: Update handle_command to support '/tokens show', '/tokens hide', and '/tokens' (toggle/display current). Update COMMANDS dict.

phases.name: Context Limit Warnings
phases.description: Implement visual warnings and notifications when approaching context limits

subtasks.title: Add warning color constants to COLORS
subtasks.description: Add token_normal (#10b981 green), token_warning (#fbbf24 yellow), token_critical (#ef4444 red) to COLORS dict

subtasks.title: Implement threshold crossing notifications

subtasks.notes: Show: '⚠️ Context at 80% - consider using /clear soon' and '🚨 Context at 95% - recommend using /clear now'

subtasks.title: Add /clear suggestion at critical threshold

phases.description: Write comprehensive tests for the new token indicator functionality

subtasks.description: Test: set_context_limit, get_usage_percentage, get_status_level, format_compact_display, should_show_warning, reset clears warnings

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for TokenUsageIndicator component
subtasks.description: Test render() at different usage levels (0%, 50%, 80%, 95%, 100%), verify correct colors

subtasks.title: Add tests for model context limits
subtasks.description: Test get_context_limit for known models, unknown models, and default fallback

phases.name: Documentation

subtasks.description: Update tokens command description to mention show/hide toggle functionality

final_acceptance: Token usage indicator displays in status area/bottom toolbar during interactive sessions
Indicator updates in real-time after each agent response
One-time warning notifications when crossing 80% and 95% thresholds
/tokens command shows detailed usage and supports show/hide toggle
Context limits are correctly loaded from models.json for all supported models
